regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative rotation: only 2 of 22 themes are eligible (Coal and Banks), dominated by Coal (score 1.137, durability_bar 0.48, mean-revert regime). The market-level macro backdrop is coincident and headline-driven (unscheduled_share 1.0). Given gate_helps=false — the trend discipline did not reduce drawdown on this market's history — and the 98-call track record shows direction accuracy of only 0.337, I default to low conviction and few theses.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed breadth catch-up in Banks (512800.SS) alongside Coal losing the rank-1 slot while Banks' durability_bar stays above 0.7; the one-narrative flag stays true means I am only watching the handoff, not pre-positioning for it.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the sole eligible, scorable leader and the confirmed one-narrative theme on this tape. Durability_bar of 0.48 is middling but the rank-1 score is the strongest momentum signal available; breadth 0.3 is thin but non-zero, and crowding is low (z 0.51, not crowded), so no size-down caution applies. This is a continuation lean on confirmed leadership, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert, not trend, and durability_bar 0.48 is below the Banks challenger's 0.8. The gate_helps=false verdict means this tape whipsaws the absolute-trend gate, so confirmed leadership may reverse quickly. Thin breadth (0.3) suggests narrow leadership that can unwind without broad participation.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) closes below its 5-day rolling low while Banks (512800.SS) makes a new high before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the eligible challenger with the strongest durability_bar (0.8, trend regime) and broadest breadth (0.778), but it is crowded (z 1.77). The guardrails explicitly forbid treating crowding as a fade signal, but crowding is a size-down caution. Combined with the rotation margin to Coal being razor-thin (0.027), the lean is to avoid adding here rather than fade or short.
theses.dissent: Banks has the strongest trend-health reading (durability 0.8) and a much healthier breadth than Coal. If a confirmed handoff to Banks occurs, avoiding it would also miss the strongest durable trend on the board.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) crowd-z falls below 1.0 while breadth stays above 0.7 before the check-by date
